p1.note: TR renders gloss "بمعنى شبه وشبيه" as "benzer, benzeyen" (like, resembling) instead of likeness and like (benzerlik ve benzer).
Turkish adds unmarked '(inne ve kardeşlerindendir)' after «حرف مشبه بالفعل»; not in Arabic. Removed.
Turkish served cut off at «﴿وَمَنْ كانَ مَرِيضاً أَوْ عَلى سَفَرٍ فَعِدَّةٌ»; remainder through ﴿تَشْكُرُونَ﴾ missing. Full text re-put.
Turkish had silently changed source "كآية يخرجونهم السابقة" to «يخرجهم»; restored «يخرجونهم» with translator note.
